question: Can the repository's existing multi-seed CEM fit a reproducible Duskblade-v5 policy repertoire for the exact v10 content where random screening did not generalise?

researchCohorts.cemTrain: six Duskblade-v5 islands, generations 0-5, eight CRN seeds per generation, 138000-138047
researchCohorts.finalValidation: all six frozen final policies, paired candidate/live, 140000-140063

competingOptions.statement: At least two independently fitted islands per route retain mediator activation and C2-viable held-out performance.
Multi-seed CEM cannot retain two route endpoints or causes reliability, collapse or ceiling failure.

estimands.optimisation: Six independent existing-tool CEM islands maximise eight-seed generation win rate; no holdout or final-validation result feeds fitting.
estimands.routeViability: For each assigned route, at least two final policies activate that mediator and exceed held-out RandomBuild arm 2 by at least 0.35 on fresh final-validation seeds.
estimands.retention: At least two distinct final policies remain within 0.10 of the overall top, and route-best rates remain within 0.10.
estimands.reliability: No CEM holdout simulator fault and no candidate-added stall or simulator error on paired final validation.
estimands.vow5: Every final-policy validation win rate is at most 0.90.

successRule.routeViability: At least two independently fitted final policies per assigned route meet activation and the 0.35 C2 margin.
successRule.retention: Both assigned routes retain high-performing distinct endpoints without one-route collapse.
successRule.reliability: No CEM holdout stall/error, no candidate-added final-validation stall, and zero simulator errors.
successRule.vow5: All final-policy win rates are at most 0.90.

cheapestDiscriminatingExperiment: Run the existing mini-CEM shape for only six Duskblade-v5 islands from route-grounded starts, then freeze all six finals and evaluate one independent paired 64-seed rectangle.
inconclusiveRule: The six-island CEM and 64-seed final rectangle are final for v11. No island replacement, extra generation, reselection or content change is allowed.
stopRule: Reject if fewer than two policies per route meet held-out activation and C2, endpoints collapse, an added stall/error appears, or Vow-5 exceeds 0.90. Detector mutations remain forbidden until the repertoire passes.
